items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-034: Server-Side Request Forgery in Dashboard RSS Widget
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to server-side request forgery in the RSS widget of the dashboard.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-033: Information Disclosure in File Dump Controller
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to information disclosure in the file dump controller.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-032: Unrestricted File Upload in Form Framework
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to unrestricted file uploads in the Form Framework.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-031: Cache Flooding in Page Cache Handling
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to denial of service through page cache flooding.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-030: Open Redirection in URL Sanitization
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to open redirection in URL sanitization.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-029: Information Disclosure in Form Framework
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to Information Disclosure in the Form Framework.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-028: Information Disclosure in Image Processing
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to information disclosure in image processing.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-027: Missing Authentication in Installer
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to missing authentication in the installer.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-026: Missing Authorization in Online Media Handling
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to missing authorization when adding online media in the backend.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-025: Path Traversal in Import/Export Module
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to path traversal in the Import/Export module.

items.title: TYPO3-PSA-2026-002: Important TYPO3 Core Security Release Pre-Announcement
items.summary: The TYPO3 Security Team pre-announces important security releases.

items.title: TYPO3-EXT-SA-2026-038: Broken Access Control in extension "Frontend User Registration" (sf_register)
items.summary: It has been discovered that the extension "Frontend User Registration" (sf_register) is vulnerable to Broken Access Control.

items.title: TYPO3-EXT-SA-2026-037: Multiple vulnerabilities in extension "Mail" (mail)
items.summary: It has been discovered that the extension "Mail" (mail) is vulnerable to Open Redirection, Information Disclosure, Broken Access Control, Server-Side Request Forgery and Cross-Site Scripting.

items.title: TYPO3-PSA-2026-001: Critical PHP security release: PHP update required for all TYPO3 installations
items.summary: Two critical security vulnerabilities in PHP require prompt action: all TYPO3 users should update PHP on their installations right away. TYPO3 itself is not affected and does not need to be updated.

items.title: TYPO3-EXT-SA-2026-036: Broken Access Control in extension "shop" (shop)
items.summary: It has been discovered that the extension "TYPO3 Shop by coding.ms" (shop) is vulnerable to  Broken Access Control.

items.title: TYPO3-EXT-SA-2026-035: Multiple vulnerabilities in extension "TYPO3 AI Integration Extension" (ns_t3ai)
items.summary: It has been discovered that the extension “TYPO3 AI Integration Extension” (ns_t3ai)  is vulnerable to Broken Access Control and Sensitive Data Exposure.

items.title: TYPO3-EXT-SA-2026-034: SQL Injection in extension "File manager" (ameos_filemanager)
items.summary: It has been discovered that the extension "File manager" (ameos_filemanager) is vulnerable to SQL Injection.

items.title: TYPO3-EXT-SA-2026-033: Multiple vulnerabilities in extension "TYPO3 Fluid-Form" (fluid_form)
items.summary: It has been discovered that the extension "TYPO3 Fluid-Form by coding.ms" (fluid_form) is vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting and Broken Access Control.

items.title: TYPO3-EXT-SA-2026-032: Server-Side Request Forgery in extension "Kitodo.Presentation" (dlf)
items.summary: It has been discovered that the extension "Kitodo.Presentation" (dlf) is vulnerable to Server-Side Request Forgery.

items.title: TYPO3-EXT-SA-2026-031: Multiple vulnerabilities in extension "Analytics" (analytics)
items.summary: It has been discovered that the extension "Analytics" (analytics) is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) and Broken Access Control.
